paragraphs.source_en: A great loser have I been ever since a child, having a rash, daring spirit, a spirit I inherited from my ancestors. When a primary-school boy, I jumped down from the second story of the schoolhouse, and had to lie abed about a week. Some may be curious enough as to ask me why I did such a rash thing. I had no special reason. I had one day been looking down from the window of the second story of the new school, when one of my classmates looked up and said in a taunt.

units.source_en: A great loser have I been ever since a child, having a rash, daring spirit, a spirit I inherited from my ancestors.
When a primary-school boy, I jumped down from the second story of the schoolhouse, and had to lie abed about a week.
Some may be curious enough as to ask me why I did such a rash thing.
I had one day been looking down from the window of the second story of the new school, when one of my classmates looked up and said in a taunt.

paragraphs.source_en: "You are a great boaster. But you cannot jump down from that height. You poor little creeping thing!" My father, seeing me come home on the back of the janitor, said in an angry tone that no strong boy could be hurt by jumping down from such a low height as from upstairs, and I assured him that he would be proud to see me come out all right next time.
